verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Let it rain, let it rain
Open the flood gates of heaven

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I feel The rain of Your Love,
I feel The wind of Your Spirit .
And now the heartbeat of heaven,
Let us hear

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We want to see You
Show us Your glory
We want to know You more
